name: Ascend Medical LLC
old_description: Ascend Medical was founded in 2014 with a goal to help the Treasure Valley have access to more orthopedic, sport bracing, and post op recovery resources. We are have expanded our company to work alongside physicians in Idaho and Utah.
about:
Ascend Medical LLC was established in 2014 in Boise, Idaho, with the aim of giving the Treasure Valley broader access to orthopedic, sport bracing, and post-operative recovery resources. The company began as a local supplier focused on patient needs and has since extended its reach to collaborate with physicians across Idaho and Utah.

The firm supplies a range of medical products including orthopedic bracing, sport bracing, wound-care items, and biologics, positioning itself as a resource for post-surgical and injury recovery. It operates from a facility on West Emerald Street in Boise, though specific headcount, facility size, and volume metrics are not disclosed.

Ascend Medical serves healthcare providers, working directly with physicians in Idaho and Utah and, in recent years, with Veterans Affairs communities. Its customer base includes clinics, hospitals, and VA facilities seeking recovery-focused products.

The company states that patient care is its top priority and that it differentiates itself by offering cutting-edge, innovative products designed to help patients recover faster from injury and surgery. This mission drove its founding and continues to guide its expansion.
